title: picardDirectImageUnitMorphism_pullback
statement: For f:X \to S, an O_X-module L, k:W \to S, i:Tprime \to T, t:T \to W and tprime:Tprime \to W with i followed by t equal to tprime, let j:X_Tprime \to X_T have the prescribed projections. Let c:L_Tprime \cong j^*L_T be the inverse mate of pushforward composition [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. For each derived test morphism \xi [def-sc-picard-derived-model-sections], let n and nprime be the unit morphisms [def-sc-picard-direct-image-unit-morphism] for \xi and its derived restriction. The tensor-to-ordinary left-adjoint comparison on O_X_T, followed by pullbackObjUnitToUnit and nprime, equals tensor pullback of n followed by c.inv, as module morphisms from j^*O_X_T to L_Tprime. No section evaluation or presheaf restriction is asserted.

proof.text: Rewrite the derived transpose at t and tprime by its single-module description. Apply its successive base-change pasting equation, then canonicalSinglePullbackSquare to u_p followed by n_t. Naturality of the single-pullback comparison moves the pulled-back source-unit map across the new fibre projection. Cancel the invertible source comparisons (only units are used) and use faithfulness of the single embedding to obtain the ordinary module square. The naturality helper follows by injectivity of the derived Hom equivalence, canonicalSingleAdjunctionTranspose and ordinary homEquiv naturality, without unfolding derived counits.

Apply the ordinary structure-unit square. Cancel its invertible unit-map prefix, obtaining ordinary pullback compatibility of n. Naturality of the unique tensor-to-ordinary left-adjoint isomorphism, followed by its inverse law, converts the coefficient comparison to c.inv and gives exactly the unchanged displayed statement.

theorem picardDirectImageUnitMorphism_pullback
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (L : X.Modules) (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) :
    let E := (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))
    ∀ {T T' : Scheme.{v}} (i : T' ⟶ T) (t : T ⟶ W) (t' : T' ⟶ W)
        (h : i ≫ t = t')
        (j : pullback f (t' ≫ k) ⟶ pullback f (t ≫ k)),
        ∀ (hj₁ : j ≫ pullback.fst f (t ≫ k) = pullback.fst f (t' ≫ k)),
          j ≫ pullback.snd f (t ≫ k) = pullback.snd f (t' ≫ k) ≫ i →
          let c := (conjugateIsoEquiv
            ((Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
              (pullback.fst f (t ≫ k)))).comp
                (Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)))
            (Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
              (pullback.fst f (t' ≫ k))))).symm
            (Modules.pushforwardComp j (pullback.fst f (t ≫ k)) ≪≫
              Modules.pushforwardCongr hj₁)
          ∀ ξ : picardDerivedModelSections E t,
            let U := SheafOfModules.unit
              (moduleRings (pullback f (t ≫ k)).toRingedSpace)
            let adj := Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)
            (adj.leftAdjointUniq (Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j)).hom.app U ≫
                SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit j.toRingCatSheafHom ≫
                picardDirectImageUnitMorphism f L W k t'
                  (picardDerivedModelRestriction E i t t' h ξ) =
              (Modules.tensorPullback j).map
                (picardDirectImageUnitMorphism f L W k t ξ) ≫ (c.app L).inv
